name: phd-unlisted-core-title-any-level
description: Red-team 2026-09-13: §4.4.1 puts no level rule on a core-knowledge course ("either at Notre Dame or at their previous institution"), but an unlisted Notre Dame course at the 50000 level or below 40000 was invisible to it — those two branches earn no credit and, in saying so, never set the `unknown` flag §4.4.1 reads to offer the DGS a title-matching course. The same title at 60000 or 40000 was offered. Credit is unchanged: both courses still count nothing.
